instruction: From the daily folder in Thunderbird, extract all emails and create a report "daily_emails.xlsx" on the desktop showing sender_address and subject for the first 4 emails sorted by date (earliest first).

metadata.explanation: Verified with Python: First 4 emails contain specific sender addresses and subjects from Jan 21-24, 2024.

The metric validates this implicitly through cell-by-cell comparison with pre-sorted expected data (Jan 21-24, 2024). While not explicit, this approach is semantically correct - if the output matches the pre-sorted expected data, sorting was done correctly. The code includes a comment explaining this (lines 52-54).
